$comment: Layer/segment taxonomy adapted from Hudson Labs 'The AI Ecosystem Stack' (Suhas Pai, 2026-06-16). 11 layers, 24 segments. Layer indices are ordered by PHYSICAL DEPENDENCY (megawatts -> wafers -> racks -> capacity -> models -> apps), which differs from Hudson's own sidebar ordering; see docs/SPEC.md 'Layer ordering'. layer=1 renders at the BOTTOM of the map.

layers.name: Energy & power
layers.constraint: Megawatts. Firm, dispatchable power is the binding constraint on AI build-out; interconnect queues run years.

layers.name: Data center physical infrastructure
layers.constraint: Thermal and electrical delivery. Liquid cooling and transformer lead times gate rack density.

layers.name: Semiconductors
layers.constraint: Advanced logic and HBM. The narrowest point in the entire stack.

layers.name: Networking
layers.constraint: Scale-up and scale-out bandwidth. Optics and switching bound cluster size.

layers.name: AI systems & hardware
layers.constraint: Integration and assembly. Low-margin but a real throughput bottleneck.

layers.name: Data centers & cloud capacity
layers.constraint: Powered shells and GPU hours. Capital-intensive, contract-backed.

layers.name: Cloud, models & platforms
layers.constraint: Frontier capability and distribution. Where compute converts to product.

layers.name: Data & AI infrastructure software
layers.constraint: Governance, retrieval and observability between model and enterprise data.

layers.name: Data & content
layers.constraint: Proprietary and licensable corpora. Increasingly rivalrous and litigated.

layers.name: Applications
layers.constraint: Workflow lock-in and distribution. Thin moats absent proprietary data.

layers.name: Applications & edge AI
layers.constraint: Physical-world deployment. Safety, latency and unit-economics bound.

segments.name: Gas turbines, generators & backup power
segments.supplies: Turbines, engines, gensets, fuel cells, and backup power systems for reliable near-term power.

segments.name: Nuclear & uranium
segments.supplies: Carbon-free firm power increasingly sought for hyperscaler offtake contracts.

segments.name: Renewables & storage
segments.supplies: Renewable PPAs, co-located power, and battery storage used to meet electricity demand.

segments.name: Utilities & firm power
segments.supplies: Grid electricity or firm generation capacity that AI data centers and clusters draw on.

segments.name: Cooling & thermal management
segments.supplies: Chillers, CRAC/CRAH, heat exchangers, liquid cooling, and pumps for dense GPU racks.

segments.name: Electrical equipment & power distribution
segments.supplies: Transformers, switchgear, UPS, power distribution, and busway to bring power to AI racks.

segments.name: Engineering, construction & grid services
segments.supplies: Data centers, substations, transmission, and mechanical/electrical work for AI clusters.

segments.name: AI accelerators, ASICs & chip IP
segments.supplies: GPUs, AI accelerators, custom ASICs, CPUs, NPUs, DPUs, and IP for training and inference.

segments.name: Memory, HBM & storage
segments.supplies: HBM, DRAM, NAND, SSDs, and memory-interface IP; memory bandwidth bounds inference performance.

segments.name: Semiconductor equipment
segments.supplies: Lithography, etch, deposition, process control, bonding, and test tooling for AI chips and memory.

segments.name: Semiconductor foundry & manufacturing
segments.supplies: Advanced logic, analog, and specialty chips used in AI accelerators, controllers, and edge AI.

segments.name: Semiconductor materials & chemicals
segments.supplies: Wafers, photoresists, gases, CMP, substrates, and thermal materials for semiconductors.

segments.name: Networking, optics & interconnect
segments.supplies: Moves data among GPUs, servers, clusters, and data centers using optics, DSPs, and switching systems.

segments.name: Servers, ODM/EMS & racks
segments.supplies: Servers, racks, motherboards, power shelves, and integrated systems for hyperscalers and enterprises.

segments.name: AI cloud & GPU compute providers
segments.supplies: Rents GPU/accelerator capacity and managed AI infrastructure to model labs and developers.

segments.name: Data center REITs & colocation
segments.supplies: Owns or operates data centers, interconnection hubs, or powered shells for cloud tenants.

segments.name: Hyperscale cloud & AI platforms
segments.supplies: Cloud infrastructure, proprietary models, AI APIs, and developer platforms driving enterprise AI adoption.

segments.name: Data platforms, MLOps & observability
segments.supplies: Organizes enterprise data, vector search, governance, and model monitoring infrastructure.

segments.name: Data, content & information rights
segments.supplies: Owns or aggregates proprietary data, news, legal/financial/scientific corpora, and media used in AI products.

segments.name: Consumer internet & media AI
segments.supplies: Uses AI for recommendations, ads, content creation, and personalization experiences.

segments.name: Cybersecurity for AI and cloud
segments.supplies: Secures AI-enabled cloud environments, identities, data, and endpoints.

segments.name: Enterprise AI applications
segments.supplies: Embeds AI copilots, agents, automation, search, analytics, and content generation into end-user software.

segments.name: Healthcare & life-sciences AI
segments.supplies: Uses AI for diagnostics, drug discovery, clinical workflows, and genomics products.

segments.name: Robotics, autonomy & edge AI
segments.supplies: Applies AI to vehicles, robots, factories, sensors, warehouses, and endpoints close to the physical world.
